cues: Aniline has molar mass ninety three, so nine point three grams is zero point one mole.
Each mole gives one mole of nitrogen gas, two point two four litres at S T P.
And eleven point two five grams of chlorobenzene in theory, or eight point four four grams at seventy five percent.
